mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: Select only supplied catalog operators with identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode=true; exclude mode-specific reserves. Ordinary three-star catalog count is 17.
DEPLOY tiles are integer [row,col]. Forbidden deployment set is exactly [[2,5],[4,7]].
Maintain at most eight deployed operators. Handoffs require completed retreat, free tile and actual DP; credit no refunds.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Assign no ordinary medic healing to civilians.
Do not replace Popukar during active officer pressure. A third blocking slot alone does not replace her damage responsibility.
Before Steward's retirement, verify the southern officers are eliminated; defer his paired handoff if necessary.
Manual skills require readiness. Time-SP pauses during active skills; delayed activations shift subsequent readiness.
Retain Melantha, Hibiscus, Beagle, Kroos, Ansel, Midnight and Adnachiel through actual completion.
Any thirteenth 280-damage hit on #6 violates the protection goal; downstream containment alone cannot establish civilian safety.
Castle-3's handoff requires actual hostile exhaustion. Keep clearance attackers until their assigned devices are destroyed.
WIN requires remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies; perfect completion additionally requires all four safe arrivals and zero protected-target deaths.
Hard cap is frame 18000, 600 seconds. No forced release or cap extension.

tactical_thesis: Keep Popukar at [3,7] facing DOWN instead of replacing her with Cardigan. Midnight supports her from [3,5]; their overlapping attack skills cover the late paired officers. Ansel holds his first range extension for that fight. Transfer Steward's completed southern damage duty to Adnachiel's top-lane damage duty. After hostile exhaustion, Castle-3 replaces Popukar and destroys roadblock #2 while the remaining defenses stay deployed.
